name: Atlas Space
summary:
Atlas Space offers a multiplayer experience in a creative and engaging setting, blending adventure with social interaction across VR, Web, Mobile and Console.

Atlas Space merges immersive virtual worlds with rich multiplayer experiences by offering players an unparalleled level of customization, community building, and interactive exploration.
